instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a **blank decorative sheet of paper** as the main subject, placed centrally in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, while still leaving visible space around the edges to reveal the ground, background environment and side elements. The sheet must feel premium, elegant and handcrafted, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers and refined clean edges, designed as a luxurious invitation base. The composition should **use the provided reference image as the foundation**, preserving its general layout, visual language and placement logic, while adapting the scene to a **“Jardim das Borboletas”** theme with a **pink and gold color palette**.

The blank sheet should remain the clear hero of the image, but surrounded by rich ornamental elements that frame it beautifully without covering the writing area. Around the paper, add delicate floral arrangements, butterflies, petals, leaves, sparkles and soft glowing dust, all arranged organically and symmetrically enough to feel elegant, but with natural movement and lightness. Include sophisticated botanical adornments inspired by a magical garden, with roses, peonies, blossoms and fine foliage in shades of blush pink, rose, champagne gold and soft metallic highlights. Butterflies should appear graceful and luminous, floating gently around the composition, adding motion, charm and a dreamy celebratory atmosphere.

Integrate the **logo/text “15 Anos Amanda”** in a refined and elegant way, harmonized with the invitation design, using premium typography styling and subtle gold detailing, as part of the ornamental composition or as a tasteful emblem. The logo should feel luxurious, feminine and celebratory, without overpowering the blank central area. Ensure the sheet still has enough clean negative space for future text placement, maintaining readability and balance.

The environment should not be flat; instead, it must feel like a story-driven magical garden scene with visible floor, soft depth, and blurred background elements suggesting flowers, foliage and a dreamy outdoor atmosphere. The background should be softly defocused but recognizable, with depth, perspective and a premium editorial look. Add gentle atmospheric haze, floating particles and subtle bokeh lights to enhance the enchanted feeling.

Lighting must be cinematic and soft, with a warm key light illuminating the sheet, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays creating depth and a magical glow. Shadows should be soft, realistic and directional. The overall mood should be luxurious, romantic, delicate and enchanting, with harmonious gradients and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, ornamental elements framing the sides and corners, visible ground and background depth, strong sense of perspective and premium invitation design.  
Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp paper texture, cinematic bokeh, editorial composition.  
Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic.  
Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range.  
Aspect ratio: 9:16.  
Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for a quinceañera invitation inspired by a butterfly garden theme.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
